admission.justification: Admission, context resolution, route survey, drift and changeset pairing must agree on the declared memory source; choosing official cards when the leaf has none would measure the wrong tree.

applicability: Leaf memory admission and onboarding readers operating on a declared memory source before onboarding cards exist.
conditions: Leaf admission requires a live memory worktree directory, its Git marker and the recorded repository identity; other contract, branch and ancestry checks remain in force.

Converted drift measurement requires knowledge/layout.json and admitted source roots. An absent collection contains zero cards and routes. Uncovered added/copied/renamed sources retain applicable storage-specific missing-onboarding findings.
Working changeset mode selects leaf memory; committed mode selects its declared memory repository. Neither mode changes that selection because the onboarding child is absent.
exclusions: For leaf admission: missing memory worktrees or Git markers and foreign repository bindings. Existing non-directory onboarding paths are never empty collections.
Legacy-format measurement and failures reading or validating a converted tree.
Waiving real per-file card creation, full quality or other authoring admission before the first realization.

evidence: clean-focused-tests.txt: 28 passed; fresh-path-before-final.txt: original wrong-tree regression; sandbox public-tool evidence.

statement: A live leaf memory worktree is valid before it has onboarding cards, and its readers measure its own absent onboarding collection as zero without selecting the official tree.
